summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 727KB payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (bun-v1.3.13), unzips it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a bundled sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line Bun-compiled CJS blob (header '// @bun @bun-cjs') using obfuscator.io-style rotated string arrays and a character-code alphabet decoder; it is not referenced from index.js and is unrelated to the advertised typed-css-modules webpack loader. The Bun runtime is fetched specifically so this obfuscated payload runs outside the Node toolchain and evades Node-based tooling and scanners on the installer's host. The package is published under the @ornikar npm scope, but package.json repository, bugs, and author fields point to an unrelated third-party GitHub account (github.com/olegstepura/typed-css-modules-loader, author 'Oleg Stepura'), consistent with scope-squat or account compromise over the legitimate loader.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
